## Summary / 改动说明

Describe the user-visible change and its scope. / 请说明面向用户的变化及其范围。

## Verification / 验证结果

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] DSH composition test when plugin behavior changes / 修改插件行为时运行 DSH 组合测试
- [ ] Desktop and narrow-window screenshots when UI changes / 修改界面时检查桌面与窄窗口截图

## Project Checks / 项目检查

- [ ] The change uses additive DSH extension points. / 改动仅使用 DSH 增量扩展点。
- [ ] New artwork includes source, license, and attribution details. / 新增美术包含源文件、许可证与署名说明。
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation stay in sync. / 英文与简体中文文档保持同步。
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed and reviewed. / 已披露并审阅具有实质影响的 AI 辅助内容。
- [ ] Logs and screenshots contain no secrets or personal paths. / 日志和截图不包含密钥或个人路径。
